usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and Opportify analyzes an email, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Analyze Email” with a shopper's address.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Analyze Email” in Opportify
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left a cart gave an email, and the action pulls lead details from it.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so “Analyze Email” runs after a scheduled check.
